messages.snippet: Dear Member, Booking is now open for the Employment Lawyers Association Annual Conference, 18–19 Sep
messages.subject: ELA Annual Conference 2025 — early-bird booking now open
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Member,

Booking is now open for the Employment Lawyers Association Annual Conference, 18–19 September 2025 at the QEII Centre, Westminster. This year's programme includes sessions on whistleblowing detriment after the latest EAT authorities, the new duty to prevent sexual harassment, and AI in the workplace. Early-bird rate ends 30 June.

Book online at the member portal.

Kind regards,
ELA Events Team
